name: Minimum Maximum-Parent Auxiliary Count
definition: For a nonempty proper maximum-generated class $C\subseteq\{0,1\}^X$, set $a(C)=\min\{r+s+1-|X|:(r,s)\in\mathcal F(C)\}$, the fewest additional coordinates in any maximum parent whose marked section is $C$.
normalization: The original positioned coordinates are visible and are not counted as auxiliaries.
comments: The minimum need not a priori occur at the least parent rank and least complementary rank simultaneously; the profile records this tradeoff.
